name: 993 Turbo three-into-one exhaust manifold, IN625 F0 concept
description: Independent concept of an IN625 three-into-one flow core to screen LPBF manufacturing without internal welds in the manifold. Kline and PorscheFanatics publish an IN625 offer at 2.9 kg per side with heat exchanger; the PET identifies the left and right parts. No public geometry is used.

classification.intended_use: CAD, DfAM, flow, pressure, acoustic and thermal screening; no manufacturing, installation, engine start or heating function authorized

provenance.record_license: All rights reserved (see LICENSE) for the concept, the script and the calculations; no photograph, PET illustration or Kline/Porsche geometry redistributed

sources.title: Kline Innovation - Porsche 993 Turbo exhaust
sources.notes: States IN625 and 2.9 kg per manifold with heat exchanger; no dimension or manufacturing method. See SRC-KLINE-993-TURBO-IN625-MANIFOLDS.

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - IN625 manifolds with heat exchanger for 993 Turbo
sources.notes: Cross-checks the Kline offer and the Fabspeed 3-into-1 precedent, without geometry or topology transfer between products. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-TURBO-IN625-MANIFOLDS.

sources.title: Porsche PET 993 - Turbo exhaust and heat exchangers 202-10
sources.notes: Identifies the left 993 211 039 55 and right 993 211 040 55 heat exchangers and the interfaces to measure, without dimensions. See SRC-PORSCHE-PET-993-TURBO-HEAT-EXCHANGER-202-10.

sources.title: EOS NickelAlloy IN625 material data sheet
sources.notes: LPBF M 290 screening reference, dependent on orientation and post-processing. See SRC-EOS-IN625-MATERIAL-DATA.

sources.title: Special Metals - INCONEL alloy 625
sources.notes: Reference wrought thermal properties, not equivalent to an LPBF allowables map. See SRC-SPECIAL-METALS-INCONEL-625.

material.grade: EOS NickelAlloy IN625 / UNS N06625 for screening
material.standard: ASTM F3055, AMS 7000 or AMS 7001 and a program-specific exhaust specification to be contracted

post_processing: complete powder removal through three open inlets and one open outlet
stress relief, heat treatment and possible HIP qualified on representative witness coupons
build plate cut-off and support removal with no internal support
machining of flanges and interfaces after adding measured machining allowances
internal finishing with controlled roughness and residual wall thickness
particulate cleaning, dye penetrant, CT and leak proof test before thermal testing
supplier_requirements: traceable powder, machine, parameters, orientation, lot and recycling
demonstrated capability on a 1.2 mm hot wall and an unsupported internal manifold
support, recoater and distortion simulation before build
coupons in critical orientations with hot, fatigue, creep and oxidation properties
CT of the three-into-one junction and metrology of walls, ports, flanges and future fastenings
comparison with the bent/welded manifold on cost, mass, loss, service life, repairability and inspection

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Compatibility of IN625 with cylinder head, studs, gaskets, heat exchanger, turbine and heat shields to be qualified after the actual materials are identified.

known_limits: Only the 993 Turbo identity, the IN625 material and the 2.9 kg mass with heat exchanger are published.
The diameters, thickness, spacings, paths, length and three-into-one junction are entirely synthetic.
The STEP omits flanges, turbine, heating heat exchanger, brackets, gaskets and installed environment.
The computed core mass of 509.97 g cannot be compared as an equivalent to the 2.9 kg commercial assembly.
The 1D flow assumes 3.6 L, 5,750 rpm, volumetric efficiency 0.95, gas at 900 K and equal sharing between cylinders.
Loss, stresses, expansion, radiation and acoustics are analytical screens, not CFD/FEA/CHT results.
The STEP proves only a single BREP with a connected internal volume and is not authorized for manufacturing or engine use.
